chunks.text: Return Policy: ShopEase Pakistan accepts returns within 7 days of delivery for most products. The item must be unused, in original packaging, with all tags and accessories intact. To start a return, go to My Orders, select the order and click 'Request Return'.

Non-returnable items: innerwear, personal care products, perfumes once opened, digital gift cards, and items marked 'Final Sale'. Customized or stitched-to-order clothing cannot be returned unless it arrives damaged or wrong.

Refund Policy: Refunds are processed within 5-7 working days after the returned item passes quality inspection. Refunds for online payments go back to the original method (card, JazzCash, Easypaisa). For Cash on Delivery orders, refunds are sent to your bank account or mobile wallet.

Damaged or wrong item: If you receive a damaged, defective or incorrect product, report it within 48 hours of delivery with photos or a short video. We will arrange a free pickup and send a replacement or full refund including shipping charges.

Delivery Timelines: Orders in Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad and Rawalpindi are delivered in 2-4 working days. Other major cities such as Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar and Hyderabad take 3-5 working days. Remote areas may take 5-8 working days.

Shipping Charges: Standard shipping is Rs. 200 for orders under Rs. 3,000. Orders of Rs. 3,000 or more qualify for free shipping nationwide. Express delivery in major cities costs an additional Rs. 350.

Courier Partners: We ship through TCS, Leopards Courier and PostEx depending on your location. Your courier and tracking number are shown in the order confirmation email and SMS once the order is dispatched.

Failed Delivery: Our courier makes up to 3 delivery attempts. If the customer is unreachable after 3 attempts, the parcel returns to our warehouse and the order is marked Cancelled. Please keep your phone reachable and share a correct address.
Accepted Payment Methods: We accept Cash on Delivery (COD), Visa and Mastercard credit or debit cards, JazzCash, Easypaisa, and direct bank transfer. COD is available for orders up to Rs. 50,000.
Payment Security: All online card payments are processed through a PCI-DSS compliant gateway with 3D Secure verification. ShopEase never stores your full card number or CVV on its servers.

Failed Payment: If money was deducted but the order was not confirmed, do not place the order again. The amount is automatically reversed to your account within 3-5 working days. If it is not, contact support with your transaction ID.
Bank Transfer: For bank transfer orders, share the payment receipt on WhatsApp or email within 24 hours. The order is processed once the payment is verified by our finance team.

Order Statuses: Pending means the order is received and awaiting confirmation. Processing means it is being packed. In Transit means the courier has picked it up. Delivered means it reached you. Cancelled means the order was cancelled by you, by us, or after failed delivery.
Tracking Your Order: Log in, open My Orders and click 'Track Order'. You can also paste the tracking number on the courier website. Tracking updates may take up to 24 hours after dispatch.

Cancelling an Order: You can cancel an order for free while its status is Pending or Processing from the My Orders page. Once the status changes to In Transit, cancellation is not possible; you may refuse the parcel or request a return after delivery.
Changing Address or Phone: The delivery address or contact number can be changed only before the order is dispatched. Contact support with your Order ID (format ORD-1001) as soon as possible.

Warranty: Electronics such as smart watches, earbuds, speakers and power banks carry a 6-month seller warranty against manufacturing defects. Some brands offer 1-year official warranty; the duration is listed on the product page.
Warranty Exclusions: Warranty does not cover physical damage, water damage, burnt circuits, unauthorized repair, or misuse. Keep your invoice and the original box for warranty claims.

Claiming Warranty: Email support with your Order ID, a short video showing the fault, and a photo of the invoice. Our team responds within 24 hours. If approved, we arrange courier pickup and repair or replace the product within 10-14 working days.

Account Help: To reset your password, click 'Forgot Password' on the login page and enter your registered email or mobile number. A 6-digit OTP will be sent by SMS. You can update your name, address book and phone number under My Account.

Privacy: We collect only the information needed to process orders, such as your name, phone number, address and email. We do not sell personal data to third parties. You can request account deletion by emailing privacy@shopease.pk.

Discount Vouchers: Enter your voucher code at checkout in the 'Promo Code' box. Only one voucher can be used per order and vouchers cannot be combined with items already on Flash Sale unless stated. Expired vouchers cannot be reactivated.

Sales Events: Major sales run on 11.11, Black Friday, Ramadan and Eid. During sale periods, delivery may take 1-2 extra days because of high order volume. Sale prices are applied automatically in your cart.

Contact Us: Customer support is available Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM (PKT). Call 0800-12345 (toll-free), WhatsApp 0300-0000000, or email support@shopease.pk. Average email response time is under 24 hours.

Escalation: If your issue is not resolved in 3 working days, reply with the word 'Escalate' and your ticket number. A senior support agent will review the case and contact you within 24 hours. Always keep your Order ID ready for faster help.
